name: TrackWith Dicloud – Privacy-First Analytics for WordPress
author: Dicloud

sections.description:
Track smarter. Respect privacy. Stay compliant.

TrackWith for WordPress is a modern, privacy-first analytics plugin built for website owners who want actionable insights without relying on invasive tracking or violating user trust.
Unlike traditional analytics tools that collect excessive personal data, TrackWith is designed from the ground up to be GDPR & CCPA compliant, ensuring your visitors’ privacy is always protected.
Whether you’re running a blog, SaaS, e-commerce site, or corporate website, TrackWith helps you understand your audience while keeping your data practices clean and ethical.

Why Choose TrackWith?

Most analytics tools force you to choose between insight vs privacy. TrackWith gives you both.

  • ✅ No personally identifiable information (PII) collected
  • ✅ EU-based data processing (privacy-friendly jurisdiction)
  • ✅ Fully compliant with GDPR & CCPA
  • ✅ No cookies required (depending on setup)
  • ✅ Lightweight & performance-friendly

You get powerful analytics without legal headaches or slowing down your site.

📊 Powerful Analytics, Made Simple

TrackWith gives you everything you need to understand your visitors:

  • Real-time visitor tracking
  • Page views & unique visitors
  • Traffic trends & behavior insights
  • Top pages & performance metrics
  • Referrer and source tracking

All presented in a clean, easy-to-understand dashboard. No data overload, just actionable insights.

🔥 Advanced Behavior Tracking

Go beyond basic analytics and understand how users actually interact with your site:

  • Session Replay
    Watch real visitor sessions to see exactly how users navigate your site

  • User Journey Tracking
    Understand paths visitors take before converting or leaving

  • Goals Tracking
    Measure conversions and key actions that matter to your business

🗺️ Visual Insights with Heatmaps

See what your users see.

  • Click heatmaps
  • Scroll tracking
  • Engagement hotspots

Understand which parts of your website actually drive interaction and which parts get ignored.

⚡ Built for Performance

TrackWith is designed to be:

  • Lightweight
  • Fast-loading
  • Minimal impact on Core Web Vitals

No bloated scripts. No unnecessary overhead.

🔐 Privacy by Design

Privacy isn’t an afterthought, it’s the foundation. TrackWith ensures:

  • No personal data collection
  • No invasive fingerprinting
  • Transparent data processing
  • Secure data handling

This makes it ideal for businesses operating in regions with strict data regulations.

Easy Setup, No Coding Required

Get started in minutes:

  1. Install the plugin
  2. Connect your TrackWith account
  3. Start tracking instantly

No complex configuration. No developer needed.

Built for Modern Web & Compliance

TrackWith is perfect for:

  • GDPR-conscious businesses
  • Privacy-first SaaS founders
  • Agencies managing client websites
  • Anyone moving away from Google Analytics

Free & Scalable

Start for free and upgrade as your needs grow.

Main Features

  • Privacy-first analytics (no PII collected)
  • GDPR & CCPA compliant tracking
  • One-click integration
  • EU-based data storage
  • Real-time visitor analytics
  • Session replay
  • Heatmaps (click & scroll tracking)
  • Goals & conversion tracking
  • Lightweight & fast performance
  • Clean and intuitive dashboard

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with TrackWith Dicloud, a third-party analytics service. The plugin sends visitor data to TrackWith’s servers to provide analytics functionality.

Service Information:
* Service Provider: TrackWith Dicloud (https://trackwith.dicloud.net)
* Data Processing: Visitor analytics and tracking data
* Service Terms: https://dicloud.net/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://dicloud.net/privacy/

Data Transmission:
This plugin transmits visitor analytics data to TrackWith Dicloud servers to provide website analytics functionality. The data includes page views, visitor sessions, and other analytics metrics. No personally identifiable information is collected or transmitted.

Service Requirements:
A TrackWith Dicloud account and API key are required to use this plugin.
sections.faq:
What is the difference between Lightweight and Advanced tracking mode?

Lightweight Mode
Optimized for performance and maximum privacy. Minimal data collection with essential analytics only.

Advanced Mode
Provides deeper insights including session replay, heatmaps, and enhanced visitor behavior tracking.
